# Elliot Awe

> Full-Stack & AI Engineer based in Accra, Ghana, building intelligent applications
> across the entire stack — from interfaces to scalable systems to AI-driven products.

Elliot Awe is a software engineer specializing in Next.js, AI agent architectures,
retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and full-stack product development. Portfolio
site: https://elliotawe.co

## Main sections

- [Home](https://elliotawe.co): Introduction, skills, and featured work
- [About](https://elliotawe.co/about): Background, philosophy, and experience
- [Projects](https://elliotawe.co/projects): Full case-study archive

## Case studies

- [AI Trend Discovery Engine](https://elliotawe.co/projects/ai-trend-discovery): LLM-powered pipeline analyzing 10k+ social media trends with 95% concept-extraction accuracy, built with Next.js, OpenAI, and Apify.
- [Eco-Friendly Logistics](https://elliotawe.co/projects/eco-logistics): Smart routing platform for sustainable delivery, reducing logistics waste by 15%, built with Laravel and Google Maps API.
- [Lumo Sage: AI Assistant](https://elliotawe.co/projects/lumo-sage): RAG-based personalized learning companion that helped 500+ students improve test scores by an average of 22%, built with Next.js, Supabase, and LangChain.
- [Alle: Intelligent CRM](https://elliotawe.co/projects/alle-crm): CRM with automated lead scoring, cutting average sales response time from 4 hours to 15 minutes, built with React and FastAPI.
- [Cany Visuals](https://elliotawe.co/projects/cany-visuals): High-performance creative portfolio for visual artists achieving a 99 Lighthouse performance score, built with Next.js and Framer Motion.
